entities.summary: Sociological Art is an artistic movement and approach to aesthetics that emerged in France in the early 1970s and became the basis for the Sociological Art Collective formed by Hervé Fischer, Fred Forest, and Jean-Paul Thenot in 1974. By 1980 the movement had dissipated, though individuals continued to work in its spirit.
